goal: Test whether fixed multiscale Haar-style contrasts of past number incidence can rank an 8-number pool with reproducible 5+ coverage beyond same-window frequency and the exact matched random 8-of-49 null.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: BOCPD estimates regime/run-length changes; v323 uses fixed dyadic past-only contrasts with no learned change point.
Gap-composition models ordered spacing within selected sets; v323 scores each number by temporal incidence contrasts across nested past blocks.

model.incidence: For each number n and past draw t, x_n(t)=1 if n appeared and 0 otherwise; target draw is never included.
model.haarContrast: For dyadic scale h, c_h(n)=mean(x_n over most recent h draws)-mean(x_n over preceding h draws).
model.standardization: z_h(n)=c_h(n)/sqrt(max(1e-12, p_hat(n)*(1-p_hat(n))*(2/h))); p_hat uses the full 2h block only.
model.score: score(n)=sum_h w_h*z_h(n), using one preregistered weight vector. Positive and negative weight families are both fixed before execution.
model.selection: Top 8 scores, ties by lower number.
model.frequencyBaseline: Top 8 empirical frequencies over the largest 2h block used by that configuration, ties by lower number.
